title: A walkthrough of password warnings you can follow
description: Every flag explains the grounds for it and leads to a next action you can verify.

blocks.text: A red list with no explanation creates anxiety and does not help finish the job. Different warnings call for different decisions.

quote.text: I don’t know why or how but I have 42 leaked passwords. Doesn’t feel so safe  to save any passwords anymore

blocks.text: Show the reason for the flag, the service it concerns and the state of the entry’s update. Tell looking at a warning apart from a confirmed fix.
Do not pass the number of warnings off as a full measure of security. The explanation has to match what is known about the particular entry.
